options: Send 2014 sector-share comparison to routine archive

O.location: left and right sides of plot
O.content: The chart visibly has separate blue "Agriculture (%)" and red "Industry (%)" vertical axis labels.
Neither 2014 mark has a printed percentage label, and no numeric tick labels are visibly printed on either vertical axis.

B.text: If blue Agriculture is encoded against the left axis and red Industry against the right axis, screen-space heights cannot establish their percentage ordering unless the chart displays equivalent axis scales or directly decodable 2014 values.
B.conditions: Applies because distinct colored vertical axis labels are visibly present; no equivalence of their numeric scales may be assumed.

O.location: plot at the vertical gridline labeled 2014
O.content: The blue circular mark is higher on the page than the red square mark.

O.location: left and right sides of plot
O.content: The left vertical axis is visibly labeled "Agriculture (%)" in blue, while the right vertical axis is visibly labeled "Industry (%)" in red.

B.text: If the blue Agriculture series and red Industry series use the same vertically comparable percentage scale, a mark higher on the page represents a larger percentage; the task routes to the follow-up record for the larger 2014 percentage.
B.conditions: Applies only if both colored series' 2014 vertical positions are directly comparable despite the separate left and right axis labels.
